d.ko: You are a playboy, fearless of bloody endings, whom even Casanova would envy: Once you get killed, time rewinds. Death may never defeat you, yet... fate prevails.
d.en: You are a playboy, fearless of bloody endings, whom even Casanova would envy: Once you get killed, time rewinds. Death may never defeat you, yet... fate prevails.
d.zh:
你是一个不怕柴刀的渣男，先天海王圣体：
无论你被杀还是自杀，时间都会倒流重置。
死亡无法战胜你，但……命运可以。
